description: The chart represents the distribution of task types, comparing two categories. The chart is divided into two slices. The larger slice, colored red, represents "Article generation" and accounts for approximately 83.2% of the total. The smaller slice, colored yellow, represents "Headline generation" and makes up around 16.8%. The percentage labels are shown next to each slice, and the chart is presented in a donut style with the title "Task Type" in the center. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with "Article generation" starting at the top left.
